# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

## cand_0001 — an all-infra-errored seed leaves the optimizer no gradient AND likely voids the re-score
Every trajectory this iteration failed with the SAME infrastructure error ("SPA deploy
failed: SPA intervention library not found at .../skills/interventions/llm-proxies/spa/scripts").
Two problems this creates for the optimizer:
1. Zero learning signal — the diagnose step has nothing to cluster; the optimizer must
   guess a "robustness" edit blind. Consider: when ≥N% of an iteration's trials are infra
   errors, surface that as a hard STOP/hold with a clear message rather than asking for a
   capability edit against noise.
2. If the SAME SPA-deploy failure recurs at RE-SCORE time, every candidate scores ~0 and
   the gate rejects on net-zero regardless of edit quality — the run cannot make progress
   and iterations are burned. Suggest: detect a broken environment (deploy failure) before
   scoring and abort the iteration as INFRA (not REJECTED), so the budget isn't consumed
   and a good edit isn't mislabeled as a failure.

## cand_0002 — the infra failure PERSISTED for a 2nd iteration; the run should have short-circuited
The exact same SPA-deploy failure that voided cand_0001 recurred verbatim on all 30 traces
this iteration. That confirms it is a PERSISTENT environment defect (a missing library on
disk), not transient noise. Concrete asks:
1. Persist an infra-health flag ACROSS iterations. Once an iteration is classified all-infra,
   the framework knows the environment is broken; it should not then spend the FINAL iteration
   asking the optimizer to make a capability edit that provably cannot be measured.
2. Distinguish "REJECTED (edit was worse)" from "UNSCORABLE (environment broke)" at the gate.
   Burning a 2-iteration budget on an unscorable environment reads as optimizer failure in the
   LEDGER when it is actually an infra failure — the run's Δ history is misleading as a result.
3. Surface the missing-path (skills/interventions/llm-proxies/spa/scripts) as a setup
   precondition check BEFORE rollouts start, failing fast with a clear operator message rather
   than aborting each rollout individually and mislabelling the cause as reward=0.
